calls.title: Outbound/signals office hours
calls.summary: The team is enhancing their sales outreach strategies by implementing successful Apollo email sequences with impressive open and reply rates, while focusing on targeted personas. Dan shared techniques for effective engagement through LinkedIn, emphasizing the importance of adaptability in messaging. Matthew discussed the importance of vetting inactive accounts to find valuable outreach opportunities, while also prioritizing companies with meaningful engagement over those with strong internal solutions, like Slack and DoorDash. The group is working on automating outreach efforts to improve efficiency and campaign precision, along with fostering a culture of open communication and quick decision-making through structured updates and one-on-one meetings to address specific challenges.
calls.keywords: Apollo sequences, outbound campaigns, email messaging, LinkedIn engagement, Rio integration, target account strategy
calls.action_items:

Explore Apollo-Rio sequence integration, evaluate permissions, and identify workflow improvements (04:57)
Broadcast process refinements and share Apollo sequences to the team for review and customization (05:30)
Provide feedback on UV’s target lists to avoid over-contacting companies with poor fit based on internal benchmarking (08:26)
Prioritize outreach based on individual usage signals and customer success insights for targeting (10:15)
Organize follow-up one-on-one meeting with Jake H. for deeper discussion (11:40)

**Dan Wathne**
Make Apollo sequences public, continue updating and refining sequences, including A/B testing variants (02:25)
Collaborate with Matthew and Jake to integrate intent signals and other sequencing improvements without overlapping existing workflows (03:45)
Provide notes about companies with strong internal experimentation tools and share insights on targeting former employees for optimized campaigns (08:50)

**Christian Liebenow**
Send any identified accounts not suitable for outreach or known to have strong internal experimentation setups to Matthew to refine targeting (08:50)

**Jake**
Continue building Rio integration and campaign systematization efforts (06:45)
